title: 1987 Topps Dave Righetti Baseball #616 New York Yankees AL All-Star Set Of  3
categoryName: Sports Mem, Cards & Fan Shop:Sports Trading Cards:Trading Card Singles
descriptionText: The product is a set of three original 1987 Topps baseball trading cards featuring Dave Righetti of the New York Yankees. These standard-sized cards are from the Major League (MLB) and are not autographed. They are part of the Topps set and are base cards, making them a valuable addition to any baseball card collection. Made in the United States, these cards capture a piece of baseball history from the 1987 season.
